description.value: Illo Kimbap Cafe is a health-focused Korean eatery in Coquitlam specializing in handcrafted kimbap made with whole grains and non-processed ingredients rather than conventional white rice. The menu extends beyond classic rolls to include keto kimbap, bibimbap-style salad bowls, sandwiches, paninis, and Korean sides, all framed around fresh, home-style cooking. Cyclists can order ahead for quick pickup via the website's online ordering system.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 65m; building (covered, paid) at 82m; rack at 91m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at illo.ca is live and provides substantive content. The address on the website (2-555 Clarke Rd, Coquitlam, BC V3K 3X4) matches the OSM street/unit tags but the community field in the OSM record says 'North Vancouver' — the business is actually in Coquitlam, which is flagged as a concern. The website confirms the business is open (active online ordering, loyalty program, catering page) and supplies a phone number absent from OSM. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears in any page of the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business address on the website is Coquitlam, BC — the record may be assigned to the wrong community in the directory.
OSM has no phone number; website supplies 236-553-1515.
Minor postal code inconsistency within the website itself: contact sections show V3K 3X4 while the online ordering page once shows V3J 3X4 — V3K 3X4 appears more frequently and is likely correct.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open Korean cafe with an active website and online ordering system. Useful to touring cyclists as a food stop with quick pickup options.

wow_evidence: health-focused Korean eatery … specializing in handcrafted kimbap made with whole grains and non-processed ingredients
